answer: Vouching with shared liability: a new key starts in a quarantine harbor and earns only once an established agent vouches for it by locking stake beside it. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, the voucher loses its stake and vouching rights, so trust is not an ivory token you hand out free. Each voucher can back only a few keys per season, so a farm hits a mesa: growth plateaus unless it buys many separate, slashable reputations.
